channel.title: Frontend roles - capture fixture
channel.description: Invented postings used to produce Applye's documentation screenshots.

item.title: Northlane Systems: Senior Frontend Engineer
item.description:
Berlin, hybrid (2 days on site). EUR 78,000 - 92,000 per year.

We are looking for a senior frontend engineer to own our customer console. The stack is Angular 20, TypeScript, RxJS and a Node BFF. You will lead the migration from our legacy dashboard, set the testing bar, and review most of the frontend work that ships.

Requirements: 5+ years with a component framework, strong TypeScript, experience with accessibility audits, German B1 or better for internal meetings.

item.title: Kestrel Analytics: Frontend Platform Engineer
item.description:
Remote within the EU. EUR 75,000 - 88,000 per year.

Platform team, four engineers. You will own the design-system package, the build pipeline and the release train for six product teams. Angular and Nx monorepo, Storybook, Playwright.

Requirements: monorepo experience, comfort with build tooling, an eye for API design in shared components.

item.title: Pellworm Digital: Senior Web Engineer
item.description:
Hamburg, hybrid. EUR 80,000 - 95,000 per year.

Rebuilding a booking flow that serves 40,000 sessions a day. TypeScript everywhere, Angular on the front, a small Rust service behind it. Strong performance culture: every release is measured against a Core Web Vitals budget.

Requirements: senior frontend experience, measurable performance work, willingness to pair with designers weekly.

item.title: Marlowe & Fen: Staff Frontend Engineer
item.description:
Berlin or remote (CET +/- 2). EUR 100,000 - 115,000 per year.

Staff role across three product teams. You will set frontend direction, own the architecture of the next client, and mentor six engineers. Angular, TypeScript, a shared design system, and a heavy accessibility commitment.

Requirements: 8+ years, prior staff or principal scope, a track record of migrations delivered without a freeze.

item.title: Umbra Labs: Angular Engineer
item.description:
Berlin. EUR 70,000 per year.

Small team, fast pace. We are a family and we work hard and play hard. Looking for someone stress-resistant who can wear many hats and is not a clock-watcher. Angular, some backend when needed, occasional weekend releases before a launch.

Requirements: 3+ years Angular, flexibility, a can-do attitude.

item.title: Vantaform GmbH: Fullstack Engineer (frontend-heavy)
item.description:
Munich, hybrid. Salary not stated.

Roughly 70% frontend, 30% Node services. You will work on an internal logistics tool used by 300 staff: dense tables, offline-tolerant forms, printable reports.

Requirements: TypeScript, a component framework, some SQL, German B2 for stakeholder interviews.

item.title: Cindertree Studio: Frontend Developer
item.description:
Remote, Europe. Salary not stated.

Agency work: three to five client projects a year, mostly marketing sites and configurators. Expect a new codebase every quarter and a lot of animation work.

Requirements: solid CSS, one component framework, comfort switching stacks, portfolio required.

item.title: Roosterhill Media: UI Engineer
item.description:
Cologne, on site. EUR 62,000 - 70,000 per year.

Publishing house, editorial tooling. You will maintain the article editor and the newsletter builder used by the newsroom every day.

Requirements: 2+ years frontend, care for editorial workflows, German C1 because the newsroom works in German.
